crossRefs.note: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

parallels.note: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son.…

translations.web: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.
translations.bsb: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled it,
translations.kjv: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
translations.asv: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled it.
